user.title: ProScan web server
user.description: Connect to ProScan's built-in web server (the same address you open in a browser).

data_description.stream_name: The Stream Name set in ProScan's Web Server settings (the last part of the stream URL).
data_description.stream_password: Only if ProScan's 'Serve Audio Stream' password is set.
data_description.monitor_password: Only if ProScan's 'Serve Scanner Monitor Mode' password is set. Needed to see the display.

abort.already_configured: This ProScan server is already set up.

data_description.stream_password: Leave blank to keep the current password.
